title: Version JSR Package
description: Update the version of a JSR package manually or automatically based on conventional commits

packageRoot.description: The root directory of the package to version

mode.description: Version update mode: manual (specify exact version) or auto (based on conventional commits)

version.description: Exact version to set (only used in manual mode, e.g., '1.2.3')

releaseAs.description: Force a specific release type in auto mode (overrides conventional commit analysis)

preid.description: Prerelease identifier (e.g., 'alpha', 'beta', 'rc'). Used with premajor, preminor, prepatch, or prerelease

push.description: Automatically push changes to GitHub after versioning
